key_insight: EvoDiff selects informative real ultrasound images for annotation, approaching fully supervised performance with substantially fewer labels.
clinical_relevance: The framework could reduce expert annotation demands when developing ultrasound AI across organs and imaging centers.
method: Uses diffusion-based feature-space optimization guided by information gain to generate synthetic probes.
Retrieves real unlabeled images with those probes; only retrieved real images are annotated and used for training.
Combines evolutionary search and curriculum-based sampling across heterogeneous ultrasound datasets.
evidence_signal: Evaluation spanned six benchmarks, 15 datasets and 16,696 images using convolutional and transformer-based models, including unseen-cohort validation; a six-radiologist study supported model-estimated annotation workload reductions of 24%–84%.
watch_item: Workload savings are model-based estimates, not demonstrated reductions in routine clinical deployment.
paper_title: Generative Active Learning for Label-Efficient Pan-Organ Ultrasound Diagnosis
